head.title: Music for the occasion.
head.intro: Christa provides live music for weddings, funerals, and private celebrations, as a soprano, harpist, or organist, alone or with a small ensemble.
head.photo_alt: Christa performing with her string trio at a private event

paragraphs.text: Music shapes a wedding as much as anything in the room, and it rewards the same care given to the flowers and the dress. Christa sings the nuptial Mass, plays the harp through the cocktail hour, and works with couples and planners to choose the repertoire, sacred or classical, traditional or contemporary, and to fit each piece to the rhythm of the liturgy and the reception.

sections.alt: Christa Dalmazio playing the harp at an event

offers.heading: Ceremonies
offers.text: Prelude, processional, the sacred moments of a Catholic or Christian wedding, and the recessional, for voice, harp, or organ.

offers.heading: Receptions & events
offers.text: Cocktail hours, dinners, anniversaries, and private gatherings, solo or with ensemble.

offers.heading: Funerals & memorials
offers.text: Cantor and instrumental music for funeral Masses and memorial services, with care and discretion.

sections.label: Choosing the music
sections.intro: A few ways to shape the music for a wedding, a funeral, or a private event. Each can be adapted to your church and your plans.

items.name: Solo harp
items.text: For the prelude, the ceremony, or the cocktail hour.

items.name: Voice and harp
items.text: Christa sings and accompanies herself at the harp, from chant and Marian hymns to classical repertoire.

items.name: Solo organ
items.text: Prelude, processional, and recessional on the church organ.

items.name: Voice and organ
items.text: Christa sings and accompanies herself at the organ, from chant and Marian hymns to classical repertoire.

items.name: Harp and string trio
items.text: Christa at the harp with a string trio, for the ceremony or the reception, depending on availability.

sections.note: Voice alone or with piano is also available.

items.q: What can Christa play or sing for a wedding?
items.a: Solo harp or organ, voice with harp or organ, harp with a string trio, or voice alone or with piano, for the ceremony and the reception.

items.q: Does she sing the nuptial Mass?
items.a: Yes. She sings the nuptial Mass and fits each piece to the rhythm of the liturgy.

items.q: Can we choose our own music?
items.a: Yes. Christa works with couples and planners to choose the repertoire, sacred or classical, traditional or contemporary.

items.q: Does she provide music for funerals and memorials?
items.a: Yes. Cantor and instrumental music for funeral Masses and memorial services, with care and discretion.
